concept: Graph-Structured Agent Episodic and Semantic Memory Architecture
summary: Dual episodic-semantic memory architecture for autonomous agents with edge decay, hierarchical abstraction, and associative retrieval.

related.concept: Bitemporal Knowledge Graphs and Entity Resolution
Ontology-Constrained Information Extraction and Triplet Mining
Graph-Guided Hallucination Mitigation and Factual Consistency Verification

facts.text: Structuring autonomous agent memory as a dual episodic-semantic knowledge graph separates temporal autobiographical episode sequences from abstracted entity knowledge, improving recall precision across multi-session horizons.
Decay-weighted edge traversal integrates recency, frequency, and emotional/task importance factors to prune inactive memory pathways while preserving reinforced causal connections.
Graph-based memory consolidation processes raw observation nodes through offline abstraction passes, merging duplicate entities and distilling high-order rules into permanent declarative nodes.
